title: Rogue Aviation – Orange County
specs: Tours include popular destinations like Huntington Beach, Newport Harbor, Dodgers Stadium, Santa Monica Pier
Flight school offers comprehensive helicopter pilot training with experienced CFIs
Must be 17 years old to get pilot license; can start training earlier
Must pass FAA medical exam and obtain minimum 3rd Class Medical Certificate
Must be able to read, speak and understand English
Passenger weight limit per seat is under 300 lbs; overweight passengers may incur fees
All ages welcome on tours; children under 2 may sit on lap with headset
Tours accommodate 1 to 3 passengers depending on helicopter

blurb: Guests can train to become helicopter pilots or take helicopter tours over Southern California. Flight training includes ground lessons and flight lessons leading to a Private Pilot's License. Tours include popular routes like the OC Triangle and LA Highlights, with options for day or night flights.
extraNote: Reschedule or cancel tours up to 48 hours before departure with fees ($50 reschedule, $100 cancel) · No-shows charged full tour price · No refunds for weather or maintenance delays; tours may be rebooked at no extra charge · Rental insurance required for renters, minimum $25,000 for R22 and $50,000 for R44 helicopters · John Wayne Airport for Orange County tours; Long Beach Airport for Los Angeles tours.
